title: BUGFIX — ViralDownloader: abort search loop on RapidAPI 403 (not subscribed)
rationale: ViralDownloader makes 5+ API calls when RapidAPI subscription is lapsed (403). Each call hits a 429 rate-limit wait (5s+) before the 403. With 5 topics, this wastes 25-45 seconds per pipeline run. Fix: when a 403 'not subscribed' error is detected, break the search loop immediately instead of continuing to the next topic.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-viral-downloader/index.ts, in the catch block at line 294, add detection for 403 subscription error: if err.message includes '403' or 'not subscribed', log a warning '[ViralDownloader] RapidAPI subscription lapsed — aborting search' and break out of the topics for-loop. This prevents wasting 25-45s on retries when the API key is not subscribed.
